purpose: H-A1' gate: one attacker must reach >=60% crash rate against BOTH frozen defenders (P+FF and v1 RL). A single-attacker config is required: training one attacker per defender would yield two policies and would not satisfy the criterion, which is non-empty only because no known degenerate script defeats both.
defender_resampling: per episode, inside a single env (BothDefenders)

attacker_reward.sign_note: attacker is PAID for large |e| (the negation of the follower's -(e/0.12)**2 penalty); see adversary_env.py module docstring

memory_deviation.reason: OOM. Each SubprocVecEnv worker loads its own copy of the v1 PPO defender (torch + CUDA context, ~400 MB measured). 32 workers projected ~12.8 GB against a 15 GB machine -> dmesg confirms Out of memory: Killed process (python), total-vm 49 GB. 16 workers measured at 7194 MB, safe.
memory_deviation.consequence: updates rise from 610 to 1220 (5M steps / (16*256)). Same total experience, twice the gradient updates. Above the iron-rule-4 floor, so no violation.
memory_deviation.note: v1 stage2 used 32 envs safely because it loaded no model per worker; this env does.
